method.sensorReads: raw production field.sample calls inside AntController.senseLocalTrail and senseTrail
method.authorCredit: positive stored Float32 node delta from production depositBrush, assigned to its GasterDeposition antId
method.fieldReconstruction: bilinear per-author cell contributions plus signed Float32 numeric residual
method.age: signal-weighted first/second moments; quantiles summarize per-read mean age in fixed 0.1 s bins

pooled.caveat: Pooled signal fractions and age moments sum raw production sample reads across seeds; this is not a unique-location or behavioral-causality estimate.
